jobs.description:
Are you a business-minded research professional with deep expertise in medical imaging who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment?
Do you enjoy combining scientific and technical expertise with commercial understanding, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?
Collective Minds is looking for a Director, Research Programs & Consortia to drive our portfolio of public and private research collaborations. This is a broad, hands-on role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international healthtech company.
About Collective Minds
Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.
About the role
As Director, Research Programs & Consortia, you will take responsibility for our portfolio of more than 10 public and private research consortia, which are a key part of Collective Minds' strategy and ongoing delivery.
Working alongside CROs, biotech and medtech companies, pharmaceutical partners, academic hospitals and research organizations, these collaborations span medical imaging, big data, analytics, and AI modeling and validation across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.
Within these projects, Collective Minds acts as a data manager and platform provider, bringing deep expertise in medical imaging to support complex research collaborations.
You will be responsible for successful project delivery, reporting and project close-outs, while coordinating project and research managers across our customer delivery organization. You will act as a playing coach andpersonally manage selected research consortia and contribute scientific and technical expertise when needed.
This is a broad, hands-on role where you will combine scientific expertise with commercial understanding, set priorities and drive results through collaboration. You will ensure projects are delivered efficiently, within agreed scope and with a clear focus on quality and business value.
Your main responsibilities:
Drive the research project portfolio, ensuring successful delivery within agreed budgets, timelines, scope and commitments.
Coordinate project and research managers, aligning priorities, following up on progress and ensuring accountability across projects.
Personally manage selected research consortia, including scientific, technical and operational activities.
Provide scientific and technical guidance across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
Manage budgets, project scope and stakeholder expectations, balancing scientific objectives with commercial priorities.
Ensure accurate reporting to customers, funders and partners, including grant deliverables and efficient project close-outs.
Collaborate with clinical and technical operations teams to plan capacity, resolve challenges and continuously improve project delivery.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a scientifically experienced and business-minded professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with a strong track record of delivering complex research projects.
You are analytical, pragmatic and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, making decisions and finding effective solutions without adding unnecessary complexity.
You communicate clearly, build trust with internal and external stakeholders and know how to balance scientific quality with business priorities and efficient execution.
We believe you have:
A strong scientific background in life sciences, medical sciences, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
Experience from a commercial life sciences, medtech, biotech, pharma, CRO or healthtech environment, including scientific and academic collaborations.
Proven experience managing complex research programs or consortia, including budgets, timelines, scope, reporting and project close-outs.
Hands-on experience with research consortia, work package delivery, grant writing, grant execution and funding-related reporting.
Strong technical skills, including scientific programming, analytical tools and data-driven research workflows.
The ability to assess complex scientific and technical requirements, make informed decisions and contribute to technical implementations when needed.
Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments.
Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive results across teams and external partners.
A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt quickly and take initiative.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel internationally as required by research projects, typically approximately every two months.
Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

Why join Collective Minds?
At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.
You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.
This is an opportunity to take responsibility for a strategically important research portfolio, work with leading scientific and industry partners and contribute to the continued growth of an international healthtech company.
We look forward to receiving your application!

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. As the category leader in dermatology, we bring together science, innovation and people who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients around the world.
We are now looking for a QC Specialist Microbiology to join our Quality Control team in Uppsala. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced microbiology professional who wants to combine scientific expertise with strategic impact in a highly regulated environment.
In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert within microbiology, providing scientific guidance and technical leadership across Quality Control and Manufacturing Operations. You will play a key role in ensuring product quality, patient safety and regulatory compliance while contributing to the continuous improvement of microbiological processes, contamination control strategies and laboratory operations.
Through your expertise, you will help strengthen our quality culture and support the delivery of products that make a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
Your team
You will join a team of approximately 14 colleagues united by a strong commitment to quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. The team combines deep expertise with a collaborative mindset, creating an environment where knowledge is openly shared, challenges are solved together and everyone contributes to common goals.
There is a strong sense of teamwork, mutual respect and accountability within the group. Open communication, a willingness to support one another and a shared ambition to succeed create a positive working environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute and perform at their best.
 
Your mission
As QC Specialist Microbiology, you will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) within microbiology, providing scientific expertise, technical guidance and support across Quality Control, Manufacturing and Technical Operations.
You will ensure that microbiological control strategies and sterilization processes remain scientifically sound, compliant and fit for purpose. You will identify and mitigate quality risks, support complex investigations and drive continuous improvements that strengthen quality, compliance and operational performance.
Working independently with a high degree of ownership, you will represent the QC function in cross-functional projects, audits, inspections and regulatory activities while acting as a trusted partner to key stakeholders across the organization.
 
Key Responsibilities
· Act as the microbiology subject matter expert (SME), providing scientific guidance, technical support and expertise within the sterilization processes
· Perform, review and approve microbiological analyses while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, quality standards and regulatory expectations. 
· Lead and or support deviation investigations, root cause analyses, CAPAs, change controls and quality risk assessments. 
· Drive continuous improvement initiatives and enhance microbiological laboratory processes, procedures and documentation. 
· Represent QC Microbiology in cross-functional projects, audits, inspections and regulatory activities. 
· Support validation, qualification and verification activities related to microbiological methods, equipment and processes. 
· Contribute to a collaborative, compliant and high-performing quality culture.
 
Your profile
You are a scientifically driven microbiology professional who combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative and solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy acting as a trusted advisor and are comfortable communicating complex scientific concepts to a broad range of stakeholders. You have experience navigating regulated environments and applying scientific judgement, quality risk management and regulatory requirements to support business decisions.
As a person, you are analytical, proactive and structured. You thrive in an environment where you can influence, improve and take ownership of complex activities while building strong relationships across functions.
 
Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.
5-8 years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or another highly regulated industry.
Strong experience in Quality Control Microbiology or a related quality function.
Proven knowledge of GMP requirements and microbiological quality systems.
Experience leading investigations, deviation management and change control activities.
Experience conducting risk assessments and applying Quality Risk Management principles.
Experience supporting audits, inspections and regulatory compliance activities.
Ability to communicate scientific concepts clearly and professionally to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience with steam sterilization, Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) and dehydrogenization processes.
Experience representing QC in cross-functional projects and improvement initiatives.
Experience coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to colleagues and stakeholders.
Knowledge of Lean, Yellow Belt methodologies or other structured continuous improvement tools.
Experience with QC result approval and release activities.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

They say, “it’s not rocket science.” We disagree.
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.  
With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more. 
SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. 
We are now looking for an AWS DevOps Engineer who will build and improve the infrastructure and deployment workflows that support our systems. Working across AWS and on-premises environments, you will help developers deliver software reliably, strengthen security through automated controls and make our systems easier to operate and monitor. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems through automation and takes ownership of system reliability. You work well across IT and development teams, share your knowledge and look for ways to make everyday operations better.
You bring:
At least three years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments.
Practical experience with infrastructure as code, using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or Jenkins.
Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in cloud or on-premises environments.
Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools, scripting in Python or Bash, and DevOps practices is an advantage.
Swedish citizenship is required for this role.
 
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
You will work closely with developers, architects and IT colleagues to improve how we build, deploy and manage our environments.
Your responsibilities include:
Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation, and automate configuration with Ansible.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based systems and applications.
Automate deployments and environment provisioning to improve consistency and reduce manual work.
Manage containerized workloads in Amazon EKS and on-premises Kubernetes environments.
Develop monitoring and observability across cloud and on-premises resources using Grafana and application performance monitoring tools.
Investigate operational incidents and improve reliability through testing, automation and lessons learned.
Build security policies and automated guardrails into infrastructure and deployment workflows.
Manage software artefacts and container images using Amazon ECR and JFrog, supporting a secure software supply chain.
Contribute to solution design, quality assurance and clear documentation of infrastructure and processes for internal use and audits.

 
BENEFITS
We offer you 
A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry. 
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development. 
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.  

You will work with colleagues across engineering and IT, develop your skills across cloud and on-premises environments, and contribute to how we build and operate our systems.
 Additional benefits 
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.  
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year. 
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.  
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. 
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. 
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance. 

 
LOCATION
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna Strand. 
 
NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. 
Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves. 
When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.  
As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role. 
 
WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. 
With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. 
We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Department of Forest Ecology and Management  
Scientific background
Atmospheric aerosols are microscopic particles that influence weather and climate, contribute to biogeochemical cycling, and facilitate the dispersal of organisms. Aquatic systems can release aerosols into the atmosphere through processes such as bubble bursting, which have been studied extensively in oceans. However, whether and how these processes operate in streams remains poorly understood.
Streams differ from oceans in their hydrodynamics and water chemistry, potentially affecting how particles are captured by bubbles and potentially transferred to the atmosphere. Recent observations suggest that streams contain ice-nucleating particles that could become airborne, raising the possibility that boreal streams represent an overlooked source of atmospheric aerosols. The magnitude of these emissions, the mechanisms driving them, and the environmental factors controlling them remain largely unknown
About the position  
The postdoctoral researcher will investigate the hypothesis that streams emit aerosols to the atmosphere and identify the mechanisms and environmental conditions governing these emissions. A central task will be to develop a flux chamber to capture aerosols emitted from stream surfaces and quantify aerosol fluxes using online particle counters and air filtration for laboratory measurements of ice-nucleating particles. The chamber is planned to be deployed in both controlled experiments and field studies in natural boreal streams. The job also includes water sampling and measurements of physicochemical water and bubble properties.
The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to experimental design, data collection and analysis, manuscript preparation, scientific publication, and other forms of research communication. The position will be supervised by Associate Professor Marcus Klaus.
The successful candidate will be expected to work independently while collaborating closely with other members of the research team and external partners. The research environment will provide opportunities to develop scientific expertise, establish collaborations, and strengthen the candidate's professional development and academic career prospects.
Your profile
We are seeking a motivated and dedicated researcher with expertise at the interface of aquatic and atmospheric sciences and a strong interest in air–water exchange processes. Applicants must hold a PhD in atmospheric sciences, aquatic sciences, physics, environmental engineering, or a related discipline. 
The applicant must have demonstrated experience in measurements of aerosols, suspended particles and/or air-water mass exchange (particles or gases) and experience conducting laboratory and/or fieldwork in aquatic and/or atmospheric systems. A track record of scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed journals is also required, as are excellent written and spoken English skills.  
Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:
Air filtration, aerosol sampling, and particle counting
Droplet freezing assays
Bubble and/or turbulence characterization
Programming and data analysis using tools such as R or MATLAB
Engineering, instrument development, or practical skills relevant to designing and constructing the flux chamber  

In addition to scientific qualifications, emphasis will be placed on personal suitability, including scientific curiosity, initiative, the ability to work independently, and a constructive and collaborative approach to teamwork. 
As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling, such as PostgreSQL.

Experience contributing to architecture decisions in large, shared codebases. 
Excellent spoken and written English.

ML platforms and MLOps tooling, such as MLflow and experiment tracking. 
PyTorch, and model deployment or inference optimization, such as TensorRT. 
Workflow orchestration and ETL. We use Flyte, but experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster or similar is just as relevant. 
Kubernetes, cloud platforms and infrastructure as code. 
Designing platforms and APIs used by many teams or users, including access control and security. 
Operating production services with high reliability requirements. 
Web application development. 
Medical imaging (DICOM, RT structures), healthcare technology or other regulated, safety-critical environments. 

Our Culture

We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.

🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com
 
Your crew

Join a highly collaborative, cross-functional team at the heart of Beyond Gravity’s Electronics business. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Programs, Production and other functions, you will contribute to the development of satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products.
As an Electronics System Engineer, you will work at system and architectural level, providing system engineering expertise for electronics hardware systems, embedded processing systems and platform and payload solutions across development projects and series production programs in the satellite electronic solutions domain.
This is a role with significant development potential. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership, broaden your technical expertise and grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities over time.
 
Your mission

The Electronics System Engineer is responsible for:
Take ownership of your scope and bring assigned tasks to completion, involving more senior colleagues when needed.
Develop and maintain satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products at system and architectural level.
Analyse and understand internal and external customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements and technical solutions.
Break down system requirements into subsystem and module requirements and establish corresponding design requirements.
Develop technical concepts and system designs appropriate to customer and project needs, considering cost, time, quality, performance and technical feasibility.
Perform and/or assess system-level analyses, including performance, radiation, structural, EMC, reliability, FDIR and HW/FPGA/SW interaction analyses.
Coordinate development activities with other teams and disciplines to ensure complete and intended implementation of the system.
Plan and execute your own activities, monitor progress against schedule and budget, and raise awareness of risks and blocking points.
Support bidding and proposal activities through technical descriptions, concept work, cost and schedule estimates and risk and opportunity assessments.
Contribute to continuous improvement of products, technologies, processes and ways of working, challenging established solutions where appropriate.
Interact with customers, suppliers and external stakeholders within your area of responsibility and provide technical know-how to support successful project execution.
Maintain and develop system-level documentation and ensure compliance with established development processes and standards.

 
Most important outputs:
Robust and efficient system solutions that meet customer and project requirements.
Successful delivery of system engineering activities within agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
Continuous development of products, technologies and engineering methods.

 
Your story

We are looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented System Engineer with a strong interest in satellite electronics and system engineering. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently and enjoy finding solutions to complex technical challenges.
You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and external partners. You are motivated by continuous learning and want to develop your expertise and responsibility over time.
This role is a great opportunity for someone with strong potential to grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities and, in time, a Senior System Engineer role.

M.Sc. in Electrical, Software or Aerospace Engineering, or corresponding experience.
Experience or good knowledge in system engineering, electronics or embedded systems, preferably within the space industry.
Understanding of requirements engineering, functional decomposition and system design.
Ability to perform or assess system-level analyses and understand HW/FPGA/SW interactions.
Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Structured and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges and risk.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

 
Nice to have’s:
Experience with satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products or ground electronics.
Knowledge of FPGA, hardware, RF, signal processing or embedded systems.
Experience with tools such as MATLAB, DOORS, PSA, FMECA, DOSRAD or Reliability.
Knowledge of ECSS, agile methods or model-based systems engineering.
Experience with technical coordination, customer interaction or proposal work.
Knowledge of product roadmaps and current technology trends.

To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!
